user.description: Update Guard reads the release notes of every pending update and compares them with your setup. It tells you what might break before you install, as a sensor and in Repairs.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Notifications on your phone when a new update shows up, and an optional AI check of changelogs.

data.wait_for_fix: Wait for the first fix of a new Home Assistant release
data.blockers: Don't update while these are running
data.auto_safe: Install safe cards and themes by themselves at night

data_description.notify: One or more, e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Leave empty for no notifications.
data_description.ai_task: An AI Task entity, e.g. Google Gemini. It double-checks lines found by keywords in app, HACS and firmware changelogs and drops false alarms. Only those lines and the names of your options and devices are sent – never values. Leave empty to not use AI.
data_description.wait_for_fix: A new monthly release (e.g. 2026.12.0) is marked Check first until 2026.12.1 or a week has passed. Most problems are fixed in .1.
data_description.blockers: E.g. the washing machine or the car charger. Safe update waits until they are off (up to 6 hours).
data_description.auto_safe: Only cards and themes rated Safe, at 04:30. Integrations, apps and Home Assistant are never installed by themselves.

options.check: Only updates that need a look (check, wait or unknown)

safe_update.name: Safe update
safe_update.description: Installs an update the safe way: not if Update Guard says wait, only with enough disk space, not while the chosen devices run, and with a backup only when last night's doesn't cover it.

force.name: Even if it says wait
force.description: Install although Update Guard says to wait.
